data.one_liner: Utility for converting between WGS84 lat/lng and MGRS coordinates.
data.what_it_does: Converts geographic coordinates between WGS84 latitude/longitude and Military Grid Reference System (MGRS) strings. It provides methods for forward conversion, reverse conversion to a point, and inverse conversion to a bounding box.
use_when: You need to work with MGRS coordinates in a Dart or Flutter application
You are porting functionality that relies on the proj4js/mgrs library
avoid_when: You need a full-featured mapping SDK with UI components and tile rendering
strengths: Simple API with three core methods: toPoint, forward, and inverse
Pure Dart implementation supporting multiple platforms including web and mobile
weaknesses: Limited scope restricted strictly to MGRS and WGS84 conversions
data.setup_notes: Simply add the dependency to pubspec.yml and import the package.
